{{Quote|You really do want to cooperate, don't you?|Calders|<ref name="DSTC-1" />}}
'''Calders''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Security guard/Legends|security guard]] who served in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Prison/Legends|detention camps]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Odik II]], quickly moving up the [[Military rank/Legends|ranks]] and becoming the entire prison facility's [[Warden/Legends|warden]]. He was reassigned to the prison planet [[Despayre]], overseeing the prisoner labor pool where the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] was being constructed before being assigned to the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station itself. By then a [[Major/Legends|major]], Calders controlled a wing of detention blocks on the superweapon prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] Calders served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], beginning his service as a [[Security guard/Legends|security guard]] stationed at [[Odik II]],<ref name="DSTC-1" /> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that contained Imperial [[Politics/Legends|political]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]] [[Prison/Legends|detention camps]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|403|Odik II}}</ref> The camps were part of a highly secret facility with many dissidents from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who refused to accept the Imperial [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. Calders's service was so exemplary that he quickly moved up the [[Military rank/Legends|ranks]] and became the entire prison facility's [[Warden/Legends|warden]].<ref name="DSTC-1" />

[[File:Deathstar_negwt.png|thumb|right|200px|The DS-1 Orbital Battle Station, in which Calders ultimately commanded a wing of detention blocks]]
Due to his work at the detention wards, Calders was considered a natural for assignment to [[Despayre]], the prison planet where the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|DS-1 Orbital Battle Station]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] was being constructed. He oversaw the prisoner labor pool and forged them into a tireless machine. Calders's work exceeded his own expectations, and he was praised by the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station's [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Cassio Tagge/Legends|Cassio Tagge]].<ref name="DSTC-1" />

Prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Calders, by then a [[Major/Legends|major]], was transferred to the completed DS-1 Orbital Battle Station itself, where he controlled a wing of detention blocks. His men were trained and understood the way he liked running things. With the prison cells empty, all Calders needed was the first prisoner contingent to fill the cells.<ref name="DSTC-1" />

==Personality and traits==
Calders willingly accepted Tarkin and Tagge's praises for his above expectations work at Despayre. His men understood the way he liked running things within the DS-1 Orbital Battle Station's detention blocks that he oversaw. With objectives to guard his prisoners and keep them in good condition until contrary orders arrived, Calders was polite to the prisoners but could hardly hide his glee when orders for the prisoners to undergo interrogation or worse came along.<ref name="DSTC-1" />

A thick-muscled bull of a [[Gender/Legends|man]] who appeared to be bursting out of his [[Imperial military uniforms/Legends|uniform]], Calders was restrained aggression in Human form. His physical strength had become his personality. He stood at a height of 1.75 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] and his [[Hair/Legends|moustache]] contained a hint of [[Color/Legends|gray]].<ref name="DSTC-1" />

==Skills and abilities==
Calders's work was so exemplary at Odik II, where he began as a security guard, that he quickly became the warden of the planet's detention facility.<ref name="DSTC-1" />

==Equipment==
Calders was equipped with a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], [[stun truncheon]], and an [[interrogator kit]] worn on his uniform's [[Belt/Legends|belt]].<ref name="DSTC-1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Calders was created for [[1991]]'s ''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]'', a ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook written by [[Bill Slavicsek]].<ref name="DSTC-1" />
